rm /tmp/frames/*; python3 -c "
import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r: break
  fs.append(f)
sel=[cv2.putText(cv2.resize(fs[i],(320,180)),str(i),(5,20),0,0.7,(0,0,255),2) for i in range(0,120,5)]
rows=[np.hstack(sel[j:j+4]) for j in range(0,24,4)]
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/frames/grid.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
"
